notes.title: Big update with new content!
notes.content:
Our team is working on a new game series, so we decided to make an update that will be the link between the games of the trilogy! So, we added:

- 2 new weapons: Machine Gun and Tomato!
- An optional final stage 7 in massage parlor entourage.
- Plot.
- Musical composition. 
- Russian localization.

If you like the game write reviews and suggestions!

Sincerely, You are Hired! team
